description: Throttles distant mob AI, culls off-screen entities, and reduces particles/block entity ticking — deferring to Sodium/Lithium/EntityCulling instead of fighting them.

mods.name: Boosters
mods.description: Throttles distant mob AI, item/XP orb ticking, and block entities, and adds extra distance-based culling for entities and particles on top of what vanilla already does. Most noticeable in farms, bases, and other high-entity-density areas; doesn't replace your chunk renderer (pair with Sodium for that). Compatible with Lithium/EntityCulling.
